newsitem.title: USA: Uni-Marts sees lower 1997 Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Uni-Marts sees lower 1997 Q1 earnings.

text.p: Uni-Marts Inc said Thursday it expected earnings for the first fiscal quarter ending January 2, 1997 to be "significantly lower" than the comparable quarter last year.
Uni-Marts reported $1.4 million or $0.22 per share for the first fiscal quarter a year earlier.
It said higher wholesale gasoline prices and intense retail price competition would lower comparable merchandise and gasoline margins.
Uni-Marts operates 404 convenience stores in Pennsylvania, Virginia, New York, New Jersey, Delaware and Maryland. Self-service gasoline is offered at 298 locations.
